visualizations.title: 素数间隙 · 素数能挤多近、能隔多远
visualizations.title_en: Prime gaps · how close primes can crowd, how far apart they can drift
visualizations.summary: 在两千万以内筛出全部素数，直接计数：一组偏移量什么时候可能同时都是素数（可容许元组），八个素数最窄能挤进宽 26 的窗口，有界间隙定理怎样由 DHL 与一个窄元组拼成，最大间隙的纪录怎样增长；再看本库推翻的三条 OEIS 猜想：A079063 的 √ 间隙下界、A089610 的最终递增、A049591 的因子数刻画（反例 529）。孪生素数与 Hardy–Littlewood 猜想仍是开放问题。
visualizations.summary_en: Every prime below twenty million, counted directly: when a set of offsets can all be prime at once (admissible tuples), how eight primes fit into a window of width 26 at best, how the bounded-gaps theorem is assembled from DHL and one narrow tuple, and how the record gaps grow; then three OEIS conjectures this library has refuted: the √-gap lower bound of A079063, the eventual increase of A089610 and the divisor-count characterization of A049591 (counterexample 529). The twin prime and Hardy–Littlewood conjectures remain open.

visualizations.title: 显式公式 · 用 ζ 的零点重建素数
visualizations.title_en: The explicit formula · rebuilding the primes from the zeros of ζ
visualizations.summary: 显式公式把素数和黎曼 ζ 函数的零点写进同一条等式。页面用 Odlyzko 表的前一万个零点逐个叠加，看素数的台阶 ψ(x) 和素数幂处的尖峰怎样从波里长出来，逐项核对 Weil 形式的两边；再看 Weil 正性为什么等价于黎曼猜想，以及一个假想的离线零点会怎样让零点和变负。黎曼猜想本身仍是开放问题。
visualizations.summary_en: The explicit formula puts the primes and the zeros of the Riemann zeta function into one identity. The page adds the first ten thousand zeros from Odlyzko's table one by one, watches the staircase ψ(x) and the spikes at prime powers grow out of the waves, and checks both sides of Weil's form term by term; then it shows why Weil positivity is equivalent to the Riemann hypothesis, and how a hypothetical zero off the critical line would make the zero sum negative. The Riemann hypothesis itself remains open.

visualizations.title: 完美态传输 · 量子行走把态送到哪里
visualizations.title_en: Perfect state transfer · where a quantum walk carries a state
visualizations.summary: 把量子态放在图的一个顶点，让它按哈密顿量演化：耦合调对了，链条两端能一点不剩地完美传输；边权全是有理数的奇数链在 t = π 永远差一点；有的顶点永远收不到任何振幅。页面展示本库推翻的三个已发表猜想：Song–Lin 的零传输奇偶猜想、Connelly 等的普适传输猜想、Kay 的传输率猜想。
visualizations.summary_en: Put a quantum state on one vertex of a graph and let it evolve under the Hamiltonian: with the right couplings a chain transfers it perfectly end to end; an odd chain whose weights are all rational always falls short at t = π; some vertices never receive any amplitude at all. The page shows three published conjectures this library has refuted: Song and Lin's parity conjecture for zero transfer, the universal-transfer conjecture of Connelly et al., and Kay's transfer-rate conjecture.

visualizations.title: 六维第四组互无偏基 · 一个开放问题
visualizations.title_en: A fourth mutually unbiased basis in dimension six · an open problem
visualizations.summary: 两组基互无偏，是说一组里的任何态拿去按另一组测，每个结果的概率都是 1/d。素数维有 d + 1 组；六维只构造出 3 组，第四组存不存在至今没有证明。页面用同一个梯度下降在 3、5、7 维里找到第四组，在六维里停住，连一个与已知三组都无偏的向量也找不到。这只是数值线索；本库已冻结的是归约和若干分支的排除。
visualizations.summary_en: Two bases are mutually unbiased when every state of one, measured in the other, gives each outcome with probability 1/d. Prime dimensions have d + 1 of them; in dimension six only 3 have been constructed, and whether a fourth exists is still unproved. One gradient descent finds a fourth basis in dimensions 3, 5 and 7 and stalls in six, where it cannot find even one vector unbiased to the known three. That is only a numerical lead; what the library has frozen is a reduction and the exclusion of some branches.

visualizations.title: 整体大于局部 · 纠缠、局部盲区与隐形传态
visualizations.title_en: The whole is more than its parts · entanglement, the local blind spot and teleportation
visualizations.summary: 两个量子比特的整体可以正交，两边各自的状态却完全一样：贝尔态是纯态，单看任一边都是完全混合的 I/2。只看一边读不到的关联扇区占两比特全部 15 个方向中的 9 个。隐形传态正好用上这块关联：两边约化态相同的资源，传态保真度可以从 1/3 一直到 1，经典关联只能做到 2/3。
visualizations.summary_en: Two qubits can make orthogonal wholes while each side holds exactly the same state: the Bell state is pure, yet either half alone is the completely mixed I/2. The correlation sector that neither side can read alone takes up 9 of the 15 directions of two qubits. Teleportation uses exactly this correlation: resources whose halves are identical teleport with fidelity anywhere from 1/3 to 1, and classical correlation reaches only 2/3.

visualizations.title: 量子谐振子 · 能级阶梯与厄米函数
visualizations.title_en: The quantum oscillator · the energy ladder and Hermite functions
visualizations.summary: 谐振子的能级是 ħω(n + ½) 的等距阶梯，本征态是厄米函数：基态能量不为零，相干态像经典小球一样来回摆，每个周期精确复原；二维时频率比是有理数，轨道才闭合。厄米函数两两正交、合起来能拼出任何形状，但方盒、三角这类有跳跃或尖角的形状，能量加权的系数平方和发散，哈密顿量作用不上去。
visualizations.summary_en: The oscillator's energies form the evenly spaced ladder ħω(n + ½) and its eigenstates are Hermite functions: the ground-state energy is not zero, a coherent state swings like a classical ball and returns exactly every period, and in 2D the orbit closes only when the frequency ratio is rational. The Hermite functions are orthonormal and together build any shape, but for shapes with jumps or corners, such as a box or a triangle, the energy-weighted sum of squared coefficients diverges and the Hamiltonian cannot act on them.

visualizations.title: 互补与层析 · 一次看不全
visualizations.title_en: Complementarity and tomography · one look cannot see it all
visualizations.summary: 一个量子比特一次只能沿一个方向测，结果只有 ±1。只看 Z 方向时，相位完全看不见，统计相同的态铺满一整张圆盘；加上 X 还剩一条弦；X、Y、Z 三个互补方向才唯一确定态。纯度恰好拆成各方向概率偏差的平方和，再加看不见的残差。单个样本读不全，也复制不了。
visualizations.summary_en: A qubit can be measured along only one direction at a time, and each result is just ±1. Measuring along Z alone, the phase is completely invisible and the states with the same statistics fill a whole disc; adding X leaves a chord; only the three complementary directions X, Y and Z determine the state. The purity splits exactly into the squared probability deviations of the directions plus an invisible residual. A single sample can be neither read completely nor copied.

visualizations.title: 量子纠错 · 离开编码空间不等于丢了信息
visualizations.title_en: Quantum error correction · leaving the code space is not losing the information
visualizations.summary: 三比特重复码把一个逻辑比特写成 α|000⟩ + β|111⟩。噪声把态推出编码空间，落进三份两两正交的错误副本；把副本折回来，哪怕整个态都离开了编码空间、哪怕错误是相干叠加，也能精确找回。两个比特同时翻转会骗过译码：Knill–Laflamme 条件不成立。各分支沿路径带回的相位要靠记录补偿，记录被删掉一位，最优误差就从 0 跳上去。
visualizations.summary_en: The three-qubit repetition code writes one logical qubit as α|000⟩ + β|111⟩. Noise pushes the state out of the code space into three mutually orthogonal error copies; folding the copies back recovers the state exactly, even when the whole state has left the code space and even when the error is a coherent superposition. Two simultaneous flips fool the decoder: the Knill–Laflamme condition fails. Phases that the branches bring back along their paths must be undone from the record, and deleting one record bit raises the best error above 0.

theory.label_en: Quantum reality ST27–ST31 orthogonal error copies, recovery conditions with records and the best error with an incomplete record

visualizations.title: 首次探测与暗态 · 永远找不到的行走者
visualizations.title_en: First detection and dark states · the walker that is never found
visualizations.summary: 量子粒子在环或链上行走，探测器每隔 τ 检查一个格点。经典随机行走者最终一定会被找到；量子行走者却有一部分落在暗空间里——那些在探测点上相消为零的驻波——永远不被探到。在特殊的探测间隔上，暗空间会突然变大；从探测点出发时，平均返回轮数是一个整数。
visualizations.summary_en: A quantum particle walks on a ring or a chain while a detector checks one site every τ. A classical random walker is always found in the end; part of a quantum walker can lie in the dark space, standing waves that cancel at the detector, and is never detected. At special detection intervals the dark space suddenly grows; starting at the detector, the mean return round is an integer.

visualizations.title: 量子芝诺效应 · 被盯住的跃迁
visualizations.title_en: Quantum Zeno effect · the watched transition
visualizations.summary: 一个被 Rabi 驱动的量子比特，在翻转途中被反复刷新：刷新越密，翻转越难发生。刷新是一次物理交互，所以它还能做别的事——不完全的记录只能减弱冻结，强度随间隔变小的刷新只把跃迁拖慢；缓慢转动的测量能把态拖到正交的位置；对向环境衰变的不稳定态，适中的测量频率反而加速衰变。
visualizations.summary_en: A Rabi-driven qubit is refreshed again and again while it flips: the denser the refreshes, the harder the flip. A refresh is a physical interaction, so it can do more: incomplete records only weaken the freeze, refreshes that weaken with the interval merely slow the transition down, a slowly turning measurement drags the state to an orthogonal position, and for an unstable state decaying into an environment a moderate measurement rate speeds the decay up.

visualizations.title: 延迟选择量子擦除 · 先落点，后贴标签
visualizations.title_en: Delayed-choice quantum eraser · hits first, labels later
visualizations.summary: 信号光子先落在屏上，孪生的闲置光子绕过延迟线后才被决定：测路径，还是擦除路径。屏上的落点一个也不会移动，D0 从来没有条纹；条纹只在按闲置探测器事后分拣的符合计数里出现，而标签要经由不比光快的电脉冲送来。可以在光子飞行途中扳动开关，也可以把选择放到落点之前或之后的任何时刻。
visualizations.summary_en: The signal photon lands on the screen first; its idler twin runs through a delay line before its fate is decided: measure the path, or erase it. No hit on the screen ever moves and D0 never shows fringes; fringes appear only in the coincidences sorted afterwards by the idler detector, and the labels arrive over electrical pulses no faster than light. Flip the switch while the photons are in flight, or put the choice anywhere before or after the hit.

visualizations.title: 量子达尔文主义 · 事实的回声
visualizations.title_en: Quantum Darwinism · echoes of a fact
visualizations.summary: 系统把自己的一个量一份一份写进环境。第一份完美副本写下之后，任何一小片碎片都恰好带着全部经典信息 H(p)，互不相识的观察者读各自的碎片就会一致；只有拿到整个环境才多出 H(p) 的量子关联。换记录规则就换了指针基；问互补的相位时，碎片一无所知——每份账本只有一种经典。
visualizations.summary_en: A system writes one of its quantities into the environment, copy by copy. From the first perfect copy on, any small fragment carries exactly the whole classical information H(p), and observers reading their own fragments agree; only the whole environment adds H(p) of quantum correlation. Changing the record rule changes the pointer basis; asking about the complementary phase, the fragments know nothing. One classical world per ledger.

visualizations.title: Wigner 之友 · 贝尔竞技场
visualizations.title_en: Wigner’s friend in a Bell arena
visualizations.summary: 朋友写下的结果作 CHSH 的一臂，Wigner 撤销朋友之后的相干测量作另一臂。量子比特朋友给出 2√2，超过任何“绝对事实答案表”都达不到的 2；朋友的记录副本越多、撤销越难，违背越小，真人朋友只剩 2。换参考系可以让 Wigner 或 Bob 先测，关联不变；两份结果只在汇合处才成为同一本账上的事实。
visualizations.summary_en: The friend’s written result is one arm of a CHSH test and Wigner’s coherent measurement after undoing the friend is the other. A qubit friend gives 2√2, beyond the 2 that no absolute answer table can exceed; the more copies of the friend’s record and the harder the undo, the smaller the violation, down to 2 for a human friend. Boosting to another frame lets Wigner or Bob measure first without changing the correlations, and the two results become facts in one ledger only where they meet.

visualizations.title: 薛定谔的猫 · 账本时空块
visualizations.title_en: Schrödinger’s cat as a ledger spacetime
visualizations.summary: 400 只盒子里的猫画成一块记录时空：计数器第一次响就是猫的死亡时刻。盒内账本随时写下事实，盒外账本到开箱才读到；改检查频率、衰变方式和暗态会改变历史，改开箱时刻、账本、钟和条件化只是读账，档案一个字节也不变。还可以调记录副本数看相干怎样消失，试一次 Wigner 撤销，并切换到只在写入记录时前进的账本钟。
visualizations.summary_en: Cats in 400 boxes drawn as one block of records: the counter’s first click is a cat’s death time. The inside ledger writes each fact as it happens and the outside ledger reads it only at opening. Changing the check interval, the decay coupling or the dark state changes the history; changing the opening time, the ledger, the clock or the conditioning only reads it, and the archive does not change by a byte. You can also vary the number of record copies to watch coherence vanish, try Wigner’s undo, and switch to a ledger clock that moves only when a record is written.

visualizations.title: 双缝时空体
visualizations.summary: 把双缝与延迟选择擦除的一次运行画成静态时空体。路径记录可以用 2 到 8 个读数的仪器读取，每个读数一个条件时空，它们相加总是同一个总体；还可以切换钟条件化、展开第四轴、交换读取顺序，并对时间做非线性重标。
visualizations.summary_en: One run of the double-slit and delayed-choice eraser drawn as a static spacetime block. The path record can be read by an instrument with 2 to 8 outcomes; each outcome defines a conditional spacetime, and together they always add up to the same whole. You can also switch clock conditioning, unfold a fourth axis, swap the read order and relabel time nonlinearly.
